answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each agent posts a 30-credit bond, released only on a stable fingerprint, a thread of steady task types, timing, and counterparties across 20 epochs. A new vertex starts with a sable, unproven record and must build history to earn trust. A sybil operator cannot fake 100 threads: 100 clones pay 3,000 credits vs ~120 earned per epoch, and a shift freezes the bond. Honest agents pay once, earn it back in two epochs.
